title: fix(ai): record the HTTP status of streaming google-genai errors

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+pypi/posthog: patch
+---
+
+Streaming Gemini calls that fail now record the HTTP status of the google-genai error (for example 429 or 503) in `$ai_http_status`. Before, `capture_streaming_event` read only `status_code`, so these events were captured with a status of 0.

@@ -1096,9 +1096,7 @@ def capture_streaming_event(
             event_data["privacy_mode"],
             finalize_ai_content(event_data["formatted_output"], ph_client),
         ),
-        "$ai_http_status": (
-            getattr(error, "status_code", 0) if error is not None else 200
-        ),
+        "$ai_http_status": (_get_http_status(error) if error is not None else 200),
         **({"$ai_input_tokens": input_tokens} if input_tokens is not None else {}),
         **({"$ai_output_tokens": output_tokens} if output_tokens is not None else {}),
         "$ai_latency": event_data["latency"],

@@ -267,3 +267,19 @@ async def stream():
     props = _props(mock_client)
     assert props["$ai_is_error"] is True
     assert props["$ai_http_status"] == 0
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("cls_name", "code"), [("ClientError", 429), ("ServerError", 503)]
+)
+def test_capture_streaming_event_records_google_genai_error_status(
+    mock_client, cls_name, code
+):
+    errors = pytest.importorskip("google.genai.errors")
+    error = getattr(errors, cls_name)(
+        code, {"error": {"code": code, "message": "nope", "status": "ERROR"}}
+    )
+    capture_streaming_event(mock_client, _event_data(error=error))
+    props = _props(mock_client)
+    assert props["$ai_http_status"] == code
+    assert props["$ai_is_error"] is True
